name: Samuel Tak Lee
profile: Hong Kong property magnate (Prudential Enterprises; owner of London's Langham Estate in Fitzrovia). Died at his London home on 24 May 2026, aged 87, per The Telegraph (cited on Wikipedia).
notes: Deceased 24 May 2026. Sources: https://www.telegraph.co.uk/business/2026/05/24/west-ends-billionaire-hong-kong-landlord-dies/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samuel_Tak_Lee. Langham Estate/Prudential Enterprises now with family/heirs.

name: Robert E "Ted" Turner
profile: Founder of CNN, TBS, TNT and Turner Broadcasting; philanthropist (UN Foundation, Nuclear Threat Initiative). Died 6 May 2026 aged 87, announced by Turner Enterprises.

name: Maurice Greenberg
current_role: Chairman Emeritus, Starr Companies (C.V. Starr & Co.); sons Jeff and Scott Greenberg took over leadership in 2025
profile: Maurice 'Hank' Greenberg (b. 1925) ran AIG from 1968 to 2005, building it into one of the world's largest insurers, then led C.V. Starr & Co. (Starr Companies), a global insurance and investment group. In 2025 he handed leadership to his sons and he chaired The Starr Foundation until 2024; he remains active in US-China and medical philanthropy.
interesting_fact: A WWII veteran, he enlisted at 17, landed at Omaha Beach on D-Day and took part in the liberation of Dachau; he later served in Korea, and credits the GI Bill for his college education.
deep_cut_fact: In 1990 he became the first Chairman of Shanghai's International Business Leaders' Advisory Council, later served as Senior Economic Advisor to the Beijing municipal government, and was made an honorary citizen of Shanghai.

public_contacts.value: Prosek Partners (listed as Starr's PR adviser, Oct 2025 release)

notes: Aged 101; Hurun-listed wealth via Starr. Best route is Starr media office (media@starr.com). Starr Foundation does not accept unsolicited proposals.

name: Sanjiv Goenka
profile: Sanjiv Goenka chairs the ~$4.9bn-revenue RPSG Group, formed in 2011 when his father RP Goenka's empire was split between him and brother Harsh. Flagship is 127-year-old Kolkata power utility CESC, alongside PCBL, Spencer's, Too Yumm! and sports (Lucknow Super Giants, Mohun Bagan, Manchester Originals). In 2026 the group announced Rs 15,800 crore capex in West Bengal across energy and more.
interesting_fact: His older brother Harsh Goenka, who runs the separate RPG Enterprises, is also a billionaire; in 2025 Sanjiv bought 70% of English cricket team Manchester Originals.
deep_cut_fact: He has chaired IIT Kharagpur's Board of Governors since 2002, nominated for a fifth time in 2021, and was CII president in 2001-02 at about 40.
notes: Energy angle is strong (CESC power utility; son Shashwat, vice chairman, pushing renewables). The @RP_SanjivGoenka X link appears on the group homepage. CII term: https://cii.in/CII_Past_presidents.aspx

name: Lorenzo Fertitta
current_role: Vice Chairman/director, Red Rock Resorts (Station Casinos); Chairman, Fertitta Capital
profile: Las Vegas-born Lorenzo Fertitta and brother Frank bought the near-bankrupt UFC for $2m in 2001; he served as its chairman/CEO and they sold to WME-IMG in 2016 at a $4bn valuation. He remains vice chairman of Red Rock Resorts, the locals-casino company founded by their father, and chairs Fertitta Capital, the family's venture/growth investment firm launched in 2017.
interesting_fact: The brothers got hooked on martial arts taking weekly lessons in their casino's basement; they bought UFC for $2m in 2001 and exited at roughly $4-5bn valuations in 2016-17.
deep_cut_fact: Before owning UFC he was a regulator of it: he sat on the Nevada State Athletic Commission from 1996 until July 2000, when he left to become president of Station Casinos. He also holds an MBA from NYU Stern, where he later funded veterans' scholarships.
notes: Fertitta Capital site had no published contact. Childhood friend of Dana White. Not to be confused with cousin Tilman Fertitta.
